IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE' and table_schema = 'D360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE;
END;

CREATE TABLE [D360].[STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE]
( 
	[H]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[CAL_B2K_TYPE] [varchar](6)  NULL,
	[CAL_B2K_ID] [varchar](12)  NULL,
	[MMYYYY] [varchar](6)  NULL,
	[BANK_ID] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[DEL_FLG] [varchar](1)  NULL,
	[HLDY_STR] [varchar](31)  NULL,
	[COMMENT_STR] [varchar](500)  NULL,
	[RECVD_STR] [varchar](31)  NULL,
	[STATUS] [varchar](1)  NULL,
	[LCHG_USER_ID] [varchar](15)  NULL,
	[LCHG_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[RCRE_USER_ID] [varchar](15)  NULL,
	[RCRE_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[TS_CNT] [varchar](max)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime2](7)  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO




IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE_SELECT_SRC' and table_schema = 'd360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE_SELECT_SRC;
END;

CREATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE_SELECT_SRC
WITH (HEAP, DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN)
AS
SELECT 			 TOP 1
				 [CAL_B2K_TYPE]
				,[CAL_B2K_ID]
				,[MMYYYY]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[HLDY_STR]
				,[COMMENT_STR]
				,[RECVD_STR]
				,[STATUS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE]
            WHERE H = 'D' AND 1=2;
			
IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE_GROUP_SRC' and table_schema = 'd360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE_GROUP_SRC;
END;

CREATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE_GROUP_SRC
WITH (HEAP, DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN)
AS
select 			 TOP 1
				 [CAL_B2K_TYPE]
				,[CAL_B2K_ID]
				,[MMYYYY]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[HLDY_STR]
				,[COMMENT_STR]
				,[RECVD_STR]
				,[STATUS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [CAL_B2K_TYPE]
				,[CAL_B2K_ID]
				,[MMYYYY]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[HLDY_STR]
				,[COMMENT_STR]
				,[RECVD_STR]
				,[STATUS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE_SELECT_SRC
	WHERE 1=2
	GROUP BY     [CAL_B2K_TYPE]
				,[CAL_B2K_ID]
				,[MMYYYY]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[HLDY_STR]
				,[COMMENT_STR]
				,[RECVD_STR]
				,[STATUS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP



CREATE TABLE [EDS].[DEP_HOLIDAYMASTTABLE]
( 
	[CAL_B2K_TYPE] [varchar](6)  NULL,
	[CAL_B2K_ID] [varchar](12)  NULL,
	[MMYYYY] [varchar](6)  NULL,
	[BANK_ID] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[DEL_FLG] [varchar](1)  NULL,
	[HLDY_STR] [varchar](31)  NULL,
	[COMMENT_STR] [varchar](500)  NULL,
	[RECVD_STR] [varchar](31)  NULL,
	[STATUS] [varchar](1)  NULL,
	[LCHG_USER_ID] [varchar](15)  NULL,
	[LCHG_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[RCRE_USER_ID] [varchar](15)  NULL,
	[RCRE_TIME] [datetime2](7)  NULL,
	[TS_CNT] [varchar](max)  NULL,
	[SCD_Start_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[SCD_End_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[isActive] [int]  NULL,
	[isLatest] [int]  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
 DISTRIBUTION = HASH(MMYYYY),
 HEAP
)
GO
